recognize_zh: 瀰漫性腫瘤細胞呈強而廣泛的膜狀與顆粒狀胞質 CD10 棕色染色；雖然 CD10 常被視為 B 細胞或生發中心標記，T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤也常見陽性，不應因此誤判為 B 系。
features: Diffuse strong CD10 staining throughout the tumor sheet
Membranous and granular cytoplasmic staining pattern
Tumor cells medium-sized with scant cytoplasm and pale oval nuclei
Scattered unstained spaces and stromal/vascular elements
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD10 shows strong, diffuse membranous and granular cytoplasmic staining in the majority of tumor cells, with negative stromal and vascular elements. CD10 is expressed in a substantial proportion of T-lymphoblastic lymphomas and does not by itself indicate B lineage. In conjunction with CD3 and TdT positivity and absent B-cell markers, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: B-LBL is CD10+ TdT+ but also CD19+, CD79a+ and PAX5+ and lacks CD3.
Burkitt is CD10+ but CD20+, TdT-negative, with a starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement.
AITL has CD10+ T follicular helper cells but they are mature, TdT-negative, and accompanied by FDC meshworks and arborizing vessels.
